messages:
Nora: dropping a tiny mock for a 'time-travel' mini-panel in the rollout timeline. Idea: click a version dot -> compact panel with commit, traffic split, quick actions, and a "jump to state" keyboard shortcut. Fig link: figma.com/...
Diego: cool. main concerns: keyboard discoverability and avoiding accidental state replays. Jump should be explicit (e.g., 't' to preview, not auto-apply).
Rina: Agree. Preview vs apply distinction is critical. Preview should open a read-only snapshot view; Apply requires a confirm action. For mobile, use a full-screen sheet not a tiny panel.
Owen: UX nit: when viewing older states, show a clear banner "Previewing snapshot from May 12 — not live" with a CTA 'Return to live' and Esc should exit the preview. Also add a timeline breadcrumb like "May 12 • v3.1".
Aisha: Accessibility/intl: 1) Panel must be reachable via keyboard from the timeline dot (Enter opens). 2) Use aria-live="polite" to announce "Previewing snapshot from May 12". 3) For RTL locales ensure the mini-panel aligns to the left to avoid overflow. 4) Keep tooltip microcopy terse: "v3.1 — 5%".
Nora: Good. Copy idea: replace "Rollback to this" with "Revert deployment to this snapshot" in the action menu to be explicit. But we also want a shorter label for the quick action column: "Revert". Thoughts?
Diego: Keep both: short label "Revert" in-scoped UI, long form in modal and audit logs. Also require typed-confirm for reverts in prod namespaces.
Rina: Audit trail must link from the confirm modal: "Show recent changes" -> expands commit list + who initiated original rollout. Also surface whether feature flags or canary policies will be affected.
Owen: Motion: prefers reduced-motion crossfade for snapshot transitions. When previewing, don't animate per-token KPIs; just show static numbers to avoid SR noise.
Aisha: Color & contrast: snapshot banner currently uses 60% opacity accent on dark bg -> fails contrast. Recommend using solid high-contrast bg with icon and text (min 4.5:1). Also add an icon-only visible label for colorblind users (e.g., clock icon + "Preview").
Nora: Implementation asks: - keyboard shortcut 'p' to toggle preview, 'a' to apply (confirm), Esc to exit - preview banner with high contrast + aria-live - typed-confirm for prod revert - audit links in confirm modal - mobile sheet for preview - localization-friendly terse tooltips - reduced-motion fallback.
designbot: Design review requested by Nora for `time-travel-mini-panel`. Reviewers: Diego, Rina, Owen, Aisha. Deadline: 2 business days. :calendar:
Nora: thanks team, I'll push updated mocks with aria-label examples and the confirm modal copy. Ping when you review the tokens and the keyboard doc.
